title: Abstract Interpretation: A Unified Lattice Model for Static Analysis of Programs by Construction or Approximation of Fixpoints
abstract_short: Foundational framework for static analysis using lattices and fixpoint computation over abstract domains.

title: Control Flow Analysis
abstract_short: Foundational paper on control flow analysis for compiler optimization, introducing interval analysis and dominators.

title: A Unified Approach to Global Program Optimization
abstract_short: Lattice-theoretic framework for global dataflow analysis enabling constant propagation, available expressions, and live variables.

title: Monotone Data Flow Analysis Frameworks
abstract_short: Generalizes Kildall's lattice approach to monotone frameworks; proves maximal fixpoint solution existence via Kildall's algorithm.

title: Efficiently Computing Static Single Assignment Form and the Control Dependence Graph
abstract_short: Efficient algorithm for computing SSA form using dominance frontiers, enabling sparse dataflow analysis and modern compiler optimizations.

title: The Program Dependence Graph and Its Use in Optimization
abstract_short: Introduces the Program Dependence Graph (PDG) representing both data and control dependences for optimization and parallelization.

title: Program Slicing
abstract_short: Introduces program slicing: extracting the subset of a program relevant to a particular computation, foundational for debugging and comprehension.

title: Precise Interprocedural Dataflow Analysis via Graph Reachability
abstract_short: Shows how interprocedural dataflow problems can be solved precisely via CFL-reachability, introducing the IFDS framework.

title: Symbolic Execution and Program Testing
abstract_short: Foundational paper on symbolic execution: executing programs with symbolic inputs to explore paths and verify properties.

title: KLEE: Unassisted and Automatic Generation of High-Coverage Tests for Complex Systems Programs
abstract_short: Practical symbolic execution engine built on LLVM that automatically generates high-coverage test suites for complex systems programs.

title: Program Analysis and Specialization for the C Programming Language
abstract_short: Introduces Andersen's inclusion-based (subset) points-to analysis for C, the most precise flow-insensitive algorithm.

title: Points-to Analysis in Almost Linear Time
abstract_short: Presents a unification-based points-to analysis achieving almost linear time via type inference on a non-standard type system.

title: A Framework for Call Graph Construction Algorithms
abstract_short: Unifying framework for understanding and comparing call graph construction algorithms for object-oriented languages.

title: Escape Analysis for Java
abstract_short: Connection-graph-based escape analysis for Java enabling stack allocation and synchronization removal optimizations.

title: Parametric Shape Analysis via 3-Valued Logic
abstract_short: Parametric framework for shape analysis using 3-valued logical structures to conservatively represent heap shapes.

title: LLVM: A Compilation Framework for Lifelong Program Analysis and Transformation
abstract_short: LLVM compiler infrastructure enabling lifelong program analysis via typed SSA-based IR with link-time and runtime optimization.

title: Modeling and Discovering Vulnerabilities with Code Property Graphs
abstract_short: Introduces Code Property Graphs merging ASTs, CFGs, and PDGs into a unified queryable graph for vulnerability discovery. Basis of Joern.

title: Strictly Declarative Specification of Sophisticated Points-to Analyses
abstract_short: Presents Doop: full end-to-end points-to analysis specified entirely in Datalog, achieving 15x speedup over prior frameworks.

title: QL: Object-oriented Queries on Relational Data
abstract_short: Describes QL, an object-oriented Datalog variant for querying relational code databases. Foundation of CodeQL/Semmle.

title: Souffle: On Synthesis of Program Analyzers
abstract_short: Souffle Datalog engine synthesizes C++ from Datalog specifications; analyzes OpenJDK7 points-to in under a minute.

title: Using Datalog for Fast and Easy Program Analysis
abstract_short: Survey and tutorial on using Datalog as specification language for program analyses, demonstrating Doop framework benefits.

title: Moving Fast with Software Verification
abstract_short: Describes deploying Facebook Infer, a compositional verification tool based on separation logic, in continuous integration at Facebook.

title: Scaling Static Analyses at Facebook
abstract_short: Industrial experience scaling Infer and Zoncolan static analyzers to tens of millions of lines at Facebook, with 100K+ issues fixed.

title: Checking System Rules Using System-Specific, Programmer-Written Compiler Extensions
abstract_short: Meta-level compilation (MC) for writing system-specific checker extensions to find bugs automatically. Led to Coverity.

title: One VM to Rule Them All
abstract_short: Truffle/Graal approach: self-optimizing AST interpreters with partial evaluation for polyglot high-performance VMs.

title: Yesterday, My Program Worked. Today, It Does Not. Why?
abstract_short: Introduces delta debugging: automatically isolating failure-inducing changes from 178K changed lines in hours.

title: A Theory of Type Polymorphism in Programming
venue: Journal of Computer and System Sciences
abstract_short: Formal type discipline for polymorphic procedures with Algorithm W for compile-time type inference; proves well-typed programs cannot go wrong.

title: Principal Type-Schemes for Functional Programs
abstract_short: Proves completeness of Algorithm W for Hindley-Milner type inference; extends to polymorphic references.

title: The Principal Type-Scheme of an Object in Combinatory Logic
abstract_short: Proves existence of principal type schemes in combinatory logic, independently discovering what becomes Hindley-Milner type inference.

title: Control-Flow Analysis of Higher-Order Languages
abstract_short: Introduces k-CFA: k-level context-sensitive control-flow analysis for higher-order functional languages (Scheme).

title: Efficient and Flexible Incremental Parsing
abstract_short: Incremental LR(k) sentential-form parsing with optimal update time; theoretical foundation for tree-sitter.

title: Tree-sitter: An Incremental Parsing System for Programming Tools
abstract_short: Production incremental parsing library generating concrete syntax trees; used in editors (Neovim, Helix) and analysis tools.

title: TAJ: Effective Taint Analysis of Web Applications
abstract_short: Industry-scale static taint analysis for Java web apps handling reflection, containers, and nested taint.

title: Finding Security Vulnerabilities in Java Applications with Static Analysis
abstract_short: Points-to-based static analysis for detecting SQL injection, XSS, and HTTP splitting in Java web applications.

title: Refinement-Based Context-Sensitive Points-To Analysis for Java
abstract_short: Demand-driven refinement approach combining CFL-reachability with successive refinement of context and heap sensitivity.

title: Thin Slicing
abstract_short: Producer-based thin slicing: only statements that compute and copy a value to the seed, excluding control dependences.

title: Cloning-Based Context-Sensitive Pointer Alias Analysis Using Binary Decision Diagrams
abstract_short: First scalable context-sensitive inclusion-based pointer analysis for Java using BDDs; introduces bddbddb Datalog-to-BDD compiler.

title: Scaling Java Points-to Analysis Using Spark
abstract_short: Spark framework for flexible points-to analysis experimentation in Soot, supporting equality/subset, field sensitivity variations.

title: Introspective Analysis: Context-Sensitivity, Across the Board
abstract_short: Two-phase introspective analysis: context-insensitive pre-analysis guides selective context-sensitive refinement for scalability.

title: Optimization of Object-Oriented Programs Using Static Class Hierarchy Analysis
abstract_short: Class hierarchy analysis (CHA) for devirtualizing method calls in OO programs; foundational for call graph construction.

title: SVF: Interprocedural Static Value-Flow Analysis in LLVM
abstract_short: Scalable interprocedural value-flow analysis tool for C built on LLVM with memory SSA and sparse analysis.

title: Principles of Program Analysis
abstract_short: Comprehensive textbook covering four major approaches: dataflow analysis, constraint-based analysis, abstract interpretation, and type/effect systems.

title: Interprocedural Slicing Using Dependence Graphs
abstract_short: Introduces system dependence graphs (SDGs) for interprocedural slicing, handling calling context with transitive dependence edges.

title: A Survey of Machine Learning for Big Code and Naturalness
abstract_short: Comprehensive survey of probabilistic models of source code and ML techniques applied to software engineering tasks.

title: On the Naturalness of Software
abstract_short: Empirically demonstrates that software is repetitive and predictable; n-gram language models capture code regularities effectively.

title: Learning Natural Coding Conventions
abstract_short: NATURALIZE framework learns codebase style and suggests revisions for stylistic consistency using statistical NLP on code.

title: Predicting Program Properties from Big Code
abstract_short: CRF-based prediction of identifier names (63%) and type annotations (81%) from codebases. Basis of JSNice.

title: code2vec: Learning Distributed Representations of Code
abstract_short: Represents code as continuous vectors via AST path decomposition; learns to predict method names from path contexts.

title: code2seq: Generating Sequences from Structured Representations of Code
abstract_short: Extends code2vec with attention-based sequence generation from AST paths for code summarization tasks.

title: CodeBERT: A Pre-Trained Model for Programming and Natural Languages
abstract_short: Bimodal pre-trained Transformer for programming and natural language, enabling code search and documentation generation.

title: GraphCodeBERT: Pre-training Code Representations with Data Flow
abstract_short: Pre-trains code representations using data flow graphs capturing variable value-origin relations, improving over CodeBERT.

title: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code
abstract_short: Introduces Codex (GPT fine-tuned on code), solves 28.8% of HumanEval problems; powers GitHub Copilot.

title: Code Llama: Open Foundation Models for Code
abstract_short: Family of open code LLMs based on Llama 2 with infilling, 100K context, and instruction following for programming.

title: StarCoder: May the Source Be with You!
abstract_short: 15.5B parameter open code model trained on 1T tokens from The Stack with 8K context and infilling capabilities.

title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract_short: Introduces the Transformer architecture based solely on attention mechanisms, replacing recurrence and convolutions.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
abstract_short: Bidirectional Transformer pre-training via masked language modeling; foundational architecture for CodeBERT and derivatives.

title: CodeSearchNet Challenge: Evaluating the State of Semantic Code Search
abstract_short: Benchmark of 6M functions across 6 languages for evaluating semantic code search; foundational dataset for code intelligence.

title: CodeXGLUE: A Machine Learning Benchmark Dataset for Code Understanding and Generation
abstract_short: Benchmark of 10 tasks across 14 datasets for code understanding and generation with BERT/GPT/Encoder-Decoder baselines.

title: A Comparative Analysis of Software Architecture Recovery Techniques
abstract_short: Comparative evaluation of six architecture recovery techniques using eight carefully verified ground-truth architectures.

title: Language Server Protocol Specification
abstract_short: Protocol standardizing IDE features (completion, go-to-definition, diagnostics) between editors and language-specific servers.

title: Static Analysis at GitHub
abstract_short: Describes GitHub's code navigation using tree-sitter parsing and stack-graph-based precise code navigation at scale.
